outputs.notes:
InlineConfirm exported from @/features/lib/front/components/InlineConfirm. Props: { message, detail?, confirmLabel?='Delete', pendingLabel?='Working…', cancelLabel?='Cancel', tone?='danger'|'warning', onConfirm: ()=>void|Promise, onCancel: ()=>void }. Owns its OWN pending+error state internally — later phases must DROP local deleting/saving/isSubmitting flags and just pass onConfirm; on a rejected onConfirm promise the panel stays open and shows the error message inline (role=alert). Renders role=group with aria-label={message}; confirm/cancel buttons use aria-label={confirmLabel}/{cancelLabel}. tone drives confirm-button color only: danger=bg-red-600, warning=bg-amber-600. Markup: outer div role='group' with border (red-200/amber-200) rounded-lg p-4 bg-white space-y-3; message as

font-medium, detail as

text-xs text-gray-500. IMPORTANT REPO QUIRK for later phases: the default `npm test` config (jest.config.js) has testPathIgnorePatterns including '/__tests__/integration/', so the plan's doneWhen `npm test -- ` reports 'No tests found' (exit 1). Run integration tests with: npx jest --testPathIgnorePatterns "/node_modules/" --runTestsByPath . Pre-existing failures unrelated to this work exist in features/feedback/__tests__/integration/AdminFeedbackPage.test.tsx (phase-5 will address feedback). No schema/migration touched.

Confirm trigger state retained (confirmDelete in LessonCard/EvidenceListItem, confirmDeleteId in QuranPage). InlineConfirm messages: 'Delete this lesson?', 'Delete this evidence item?', 'Delete this session?' — these are the role=group aria-label values testable via getByRole('group', { name: /.../ }). InlineConfirm confirm button aria-label defaults to 'Delete'; cancel defaults to 'Cancel'. Tests updated to assert InlineConfirm markup (role=group) and use name='Delete'/'Cancel' for button selectors; error-keeps-open tests added for EvidenceListItem and QuranPage.
